title: Cache of `intermediateMountPoint` in `libpod` is unused
body:
### Issue Description

The method `getIntermediateMountpointUser` in `libpod` seems to have an intention to use a caching mechanism for a recreated mountpoint. However, it doesn't assign to the cache at all, so `intermediateMountPoint` is always `""`, the mountpoint is recreated on every call, and the code in the method after the `if` statement should be inaccessible. https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/0e9e3005aae0b5d863da0df41d31b4471ddc35c6/libpod/container_internal.go#L2625-L2627

Introducing commit: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/23032/changes/49eb5af3013ef64bd017a1fd545c802e3eb230a1.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

I didn't reproduce the issue, I'm only reasoning about the code.

### Describe the results you received

The cache is never assigned to, (probably) resulting in unnecessary code execution/dead code.

### Describe the results you expected

I would expect the code to assign the recreated mountpoint to the cache in the first call, and use the cached one in the subsequent calls.

Alternatively, if it is not feasible to use the cache at all, I would assume it's better to get the unused code removed.
